Chapter 285: Chapter 1: Gains, Upload, the Conclusion of the Heiyu Family (Please Subscribe)

Chikun Main Star.

Deep within the Thirteen Peaks, in the palace.

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes.

“Finally back…”

Looking around at the familiar scene, Lin Yuan let out a sigh of relief.

The five hundred years in the Central Earth World had a significant impact on Lin Yuan,

...

especially the last step into the Seventh Rank Realm, even if it wasn’t the Seventh Rank that Lin Yuan desired.

But it let Lin Yuan witness scenes he had never been able to access before.

The higher one stands, the farther and wider one sees.

“I hope this backup plan will never be needed…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Before leaving, Lin Yuan had made a special trip back to the Central Divine Continent,

and had carefully placed his physical body in a secret location,

only then did his consciousness return.

The purpose of this action

was to ensure that if he ever returned to the Central Earth World one day,

he could directly take over the body he had left behind and grasp the world’s strongest power at the fastest speed.

After breaking through to the Sixth Rank, more “functions” of the Door to the Myriad Realms appeared,

including the ability to return to worlds he had previously traversed.

But even if he were to return, Lin Yuan would choose Consciousness Descent,

because to move the physical body is both risky and consumes more World-Breaking Origin Force.

With Consciousness Descent, one can only start from the beginning of cultivation,

regardless of how high one’s realm is, it will require time to progress step by step.

But with his body left behind, everything becomes simple.

One merely needs to detach the consciousness, enter the body,

and then regain the strongest power in the Central Earth World.

Of course.

Although he had left this backup plan,

Lin Yuan did not wish for it to be used.

Because that would mean—

something unpredictable had happened in the Central Earth World,

posing a danger that could overturn the Martial Tao Cultivation System.

Descending again into the Central Earth World requires the expenditure of ten strands of World-Breaking Origin Force.

Unless absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan wouldn’t choose to do this.

“The Spirit Realm…”

Lin Yuan’s expression fell into brief contemplation.

In the last thirty years of his stay,

Lin Yuan roamed alone in the space-time chaos outside the world, and had also gazed at the enormous Spirit Realm located above from a distance.

It was an entity far surpassing the Central Earth World,

and the myriad auras it emitted fell like radiation,

firmly locking down millions of Lower Realms including the Central Earth World.

“It’s a pity, ascending directly to the Spirit Realm is still too risky; there’s no need to do that.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The Spirit Realm’s world hierarchy is very high, this is unquestionable,

where there are beings comparable to the Eighth Layer of the Main World, Immortal King Level powerhouses, and even existences beyond the Immortal King Level.

If Lin Yuan were to enter the Spirit Realm as a Dao Integration Stage ascender, he would certainly attract a lot of attention.

In such a situation… even if Lin Yuan were only a Consciousness Descent, unafraid of death, he could not guarantee absolute safety.

In front of those true powerhouses, even if Lin Yuan wanted to die, it wouldn’t necessarily be possible; he could be subjected to Soul Search and risk exposing information about the Main World.

Furthermore,

the reason Lin Yuan hadn’t entered the Spirit Realm through the Ascension Platform was virtually the same.

The Azure Ancestor from the Daode Immortal Sect, although bound by a Dao Oath in front of him,

would still be a cause for concern should Lin Yuan truly ascend to the Spirit Realm and fall into the hands of those Dao Integration Immortals.

Unforeseen incidents could occur.

Lin Yuan has never allowed himself to be in a passive position.

Besides, with the coordinates of the Spirit Realm, Lin Yuan could enter unnoticeably, without having to take risks.

At least,

as long as he has not entered the Spirit Realm through the Ascension Platform,

the Martial Tao Cultivation System of the Central Earth World is unlikely to be suppressed,

at least the Immortal Sect’s ancestors from the upper worlds will be wary—

of the possibility of Lin Yuan suddenly appearing.

…

“Forget about these things.”

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts and no longer focused on the affairs of the Central Divine China World.

Now that he had left, it was pointless to think too much.

“Regarding the gains from this transference…”

Lin Yuan was in a good mood. In five hundred years in the Central Earth World, not only had Lin Yuan reached the pinnacle of the Sixth Rank, but he had also fully explored a path to the Seventh Rank.

One must know… Evolvers in the Main World striving to step into the Seventh Rank often paid an unknown price, evolving their own paths, achieving Flesh Soul Perfection, and so on.

Members of the Red Kun Lineage, the fourth, fifth, sixth… to the twelfth disciples of the Chikun Star Lord,

were all true evolution geniuses, plus they had the guidance of the Star Lord, but were still stuck at the Sixth Rank.

Is it because these brothers are not capable? Not at all, but the difficulty of stepping from the Sixth Rank into the Seventh Rank is immense.

This transition is a metamorphosis of the essence of life, which is even more challenging than the leap from the Fifth Rank to the Sixth Rank.

Lin Yuan deeply understood this; after forcibly stepping into the Seventh Rank, he too felt the gap between realms.

“Space…”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In the last few decades of the fifth transference, Lin Yuan’s insight into space soared like a rocket.

In the space-time chaos, Lin Yuan saw another side of space, one filled with destruction,

and compared it with the calm, stable, and orderly space of the Main World. Under the contemplation of Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Lin Yuan reached directly to the essence of space.

It can be said that this transference brought Lin Yuan greater gains in the aspect of Space Rules than stepping into the Seventh Rank.

“I can feel that the Seventh Rank Martial Tao I desire relates to Space Rules, but I still haven’t devised a satisfactory Seventh Rank Chapter because my understanding of Space Rules is not deep enough…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Space Rules are vast and are the underlying rules supporting the world. The more Lin Yuan comprehends, the more he feels his insignificance in the realm of Space Rules.

If before, Lin Yuan was looking at the sky through the opening of a well, that was Space Rules,

then now, Lin Yuan had climbed out of the well to see an even more boundless expanse of the sky.
